title: Mount Kailash as an energy vortex where fingernails grow faster
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Mount Kailash as an energy vortex where fingernails grow faster, about unspecified at Mount Kailash, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Mount Kyash is an example. I think Sod Guru went and said that his fingernails grew faster on the mountain

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, describes a mountain called Mount Kailash as an "energy vortex", a place where some special force is said to gather. As proof, he passes on what a man he calls Sod Guru said: that his fingernails grew faster while he was on the mountain. If true, it would mean the place itself changes the human body in some way.
